title: China’s answer to Boeing and Airbus makes first international flight — could COMAC challenge the aviation duopoly?
summary_full: China’s C919 has made its first scheduled international commercial flight, a milestone in COMAC’s bid to challenge Boeing and Airbus globally.
summary_public: China’s C919 has made its first scheduled international commercial flight, a milestone in COMAC’s bid to challenge Boeing and Airbus globally.
